crossRefs.note: It will be health to your body, and nourishment to your bones.
His hands are like rings of gold set with beryl. His body is like ivory work overlaid with sapphires.
Your sons will take the place of your fathers. You shall make them princes in all the earth.
“Listen to me, house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, that have been carried from their birth…
“Before I formed you in the womb, I knew you. Before you were born, I sanctified you. I have appointed you a prophet to…
Therefore, my brothers, you also were made dead to the law through the body of Christ, that you would be joined to…

translations.web: Your body is like a round goblet, no mixed wine is wanting. Your waist is like a heap of wheat, set about with lilies.
translations.bsb: Your navel is a rounded goblet; it never lacks blended wine. Your waist is a mound of wheat encircled by the lilies.
translations.kjv: Thy navel is like a round goblet, which wanteth not liquor: thy belly is like an heap of wheat set about with lilies.
translations.asv: Thy body is like a round goblet, Wherein no mingled wine is wanting: Thy waist is like a heap of wheat Set about with lilies.
